projects.title: Crystal-field inverse modeling
projects.text: Magnetic susceptibility can be consistent with multiple crystal-field parameter sets. I use a residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) with a conditional Gaussian mixture model (cGMM) to represent several plausible inverse solutions rather than a single estimate. I check candidates through forward susceptibility reconstruction and study robustness using simulated curves, noise augmentation, and experimental measurements.

projects.title: Magnetic-scattering inverse modeling
projects.text: I infer exchange parameters from powder-averaged neutron-scattering maps using MLP and ResNet conditional Gaussian mixture models. I validate candidates with Sunny forward calculations and use classical fits as references. Robustness studies examine noise, intensity scaling, and background offsets in simulated maps.

projects.title: Neural-network backflow and VMC
projects.text: I implement neural-network backflow wavefunctions and variational Monte Carlo (VMC) for lattice Hubbard models of correlated fermions in JAX. My work includes GPU and multi-GPU sampling, local-energy evaluation, numerical consistency checks, and runtime profiling.
